name: item
useFor: Use Item for rows that pair a glyph or avatar with a title and a line of detail: menu entries, repositories, integrations, settings links. Make the row a link or button with asChild so the whole row is the target. Use variant="ruled" for a feature or integration list, outline for a single highlighted entry, and ItemGroup around a list.
constraints: A filled row at rest in the default variant
An arrow that moves on hover
source: The Hoplite website's nav rows (.hn__item, .hn__item-label, .hn__item-body), news card (.hn__news) and integration list (.iw-item, Wired into your stack)
title: Item
description: A row of content: the nav's menu row (a 20px glyph, a 14px medium label over a quiet description, the paper under the pointer), the news card's quiet frame, a paper row, or the home page's ruled integration row with a 20px Chakra Petch title.
